metadata.name: consensus.chainFrom
metadata.description: (checkpoints, hash) — parent-linked hashes from `hash` to root, newest first; [] if absent.

metadata.name: consensus.tip
metadata.description: (checkpoints) — the highest-epoch checkpoint hash, or '' if none.

metadata.name: consensus.mergeBase
metadata.description: (checkpoints, hashA, hashB) — most-recent common checkpoint of the two chains, or ''.

metadata.name: consensus.isDescendant
metadata.description: (checkpoints, hash, ancestor) — true iff `ancestor` is on the chain from `hash`.

metadata.name: consensus.mergeVV
metadata.description: (vvA, vvB) — merge two version vectors, taking the max db_version per site.

metadata.name: consensus.converged
metadata.description: (rootA, rootB) — merge-confirm: true iff two replicas' state-root hashes are equal and non-empty.
